result.instructions: Tools for Vidyard, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our Vidyard players mention pricing in the description?"; "List the videos that are still encoding."; "Show the tags on the player called Q3 onboarding.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vidyard data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vidyard_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vidyard_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vidyard_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vidyard_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vidyard_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the Vidyard accounts this API token can reach, with the token's roles and permissions. Good first call to check the connection. The token value itself is never returned. Dashboard API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: vidyard_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the organizations (folders) this token can access. Organization ids are needed by some other tools. Dashboard API: GET /organizations.

tools.name: vidyard_get_organization
tools.title: Get an organization
tools.description: Get one organization (folder) by id. Dashboard API: GET /organizations/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles in the account. Shows what the token's role may do. Dashboard API: GET /roles.

tools.name: vidyard_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the account, optionally filtered by team. Dashboard API: GET /users.

invite_accepted_only.description: Only users who accepted their invite.

tools.name: vidyard_list_hubs
tools.title: List hubs
tools.description: List Vidyard hubs (branded video pages) in the account. Dashboard API: GET /hubs.

tools.name: vidyard_list_players
tools.title: List players
tools.description: List players (the shareable video pages that wrap a video) in the account. Use vidyard_search_players to filter by name or tag. Dashboard API: GET /players.

order_by.description: Field to sort by, as Vidyard names it (for example created_at).

tools.name: vidyard_search_players
tools.title: Search players
tools.description: Search players by name, UUID, description, tags or internal notes. All filters combine with AND. Results are paginated. Dashboard API: GET /players/search.

internal_notes.description: Text in the player's internal notes.

tags.description: Tag names; a player must carry all of them.

tools.name: vidyard_get_player
tools.title: Get a player
tools.description: Get one player by id: name, description, status, embed and sharing settings. Dashboard API: GET /players/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_get_player_by_uuid
tools.title: Get a player by UUID
tools.description: Get one player by its UUID. Dashboard API: GET /players/uuid={uuid}.

tools.name: vidyard_get_player_tags
tools.title: Get a player's tags
tools.description: List the tags attached to one player. Dashboard API: GET /players/{player_id}/tags.

tools.name: vidyard_list_videos
tools.title: List videos
tools.description: List videos in the account. A player wraps a video; use vidyard_list_players for the shareable page. Dashboard API: GET /videos.

order_by.description: Field to sort by, as Vidyard names it.

tools.name: vidyard_get_video
tools.title: Get a video
tools.description: Get one video by id: name, description, status and length. Dashboard API: GET /videos/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_get_video_status
tools.title: Get a video's length and status
tools.description: Get the current length of a video. Use it for a video still in progress. Dashboard API: GET /videos/{id}/status.

annotations.title: Get a video's length and status

tools.name: vidyard_get_video_encoding_status
tools.title: Get a video's encoding status
tools.description: Get the encoding status of a video after upload (is it ready to play). Dashboard API: GET /videos/{id}/encoding_status.

tools.name: vidyard_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags, optionally filtered by name or by the id of the item they tag. Dashboard API: GET /tags.

taggable_id.description: Id of the tagged player or uploader widget.

tools.name: vidyard_list_tag_names
tools.title: List tag names
tools.description: List distinct tag names that contain a search string. Dashboard API: GET /tags/names.

organization_ids.description: Organization ids to search across (same account).

tools.name: vidyard_search_events
tools.title: Search events
tools.description: Search interactive events (CTAs, overlays, popups) that belong to the organization. Dashboard API: GET /events/search.

type.description: Event type, as Vidyard names it (for example fullscreen).

shared_only.description: Only events shared with other folders.

tools.name: vidyard_update_player
tools.title: Update a player
tools.description: Change a player's name or description. Other fields are left as they are. Use the player id from vidyard_search_players. Dashboard API: PATCH /players/{id}.

tools.name: vidyard_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: Create a new tag and attach it to one player or uploader widget. New tags must use Player or UploaderWidget (Vidyard no longer accepts Video for new tags). Dashboard API: POST /tags.

taggable_id.description: Integer id of the player or uploader widget.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Vidyard
prompts.description: What you can do with Vidyard here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_players_by_name_tag_or_description
prompts.title: Find players by name, tag or description
prompts.description: Search players by name, UUID, description, tags or internal notes. Read the settings and tags of one player.

prompts.name: check_which_videos_are_still_encoding
prompts.title: Check which videos are still encoding
prompts.description: List videos and read the encoding status of each one. Check the current length of a video that is still in progress.

prompts.name: review_hubs_and_the_users_in_the_account
prompts.title: Review hubs and the users in the account
prompts.description: List the hubs, which are branded video pages, and the users of the account. Filter the users by team.

prompts.name: rename_a_player_or_change_its_description
prompts.title: Rename a player or change its description
prompts.description: Change the name or description of one player. Other fields are left as they are.

prompts.name: tag_a_player_for_a_campaign
prompts.title: Tag a player for a campaign
prompts.description: Create a tag and attach it to a player or uploader widget. Check the existing tags of the player first.
